basic_details.job_title: NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (Life Science) Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Life Science at the National Institute of Technology Rourkela (an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India) will hold a walk-in interview on 2 December 2026 at 10:00 AM for one Junior Research Fellow (PhD) post in a CSIR-funded project. The pay is Rs. 37,000 in Year 1 and Year 2 and Rs. 42,000 in Year 3. Candidates need a qualifying degree with 55% marks and a NET/GATE pass in a relevant discipline of biological sciences. The engagement is temporary and contractual.

how_to_apply: The notice describes a walk-in (offline) interview. Candidates should appear on 2 December 2026 at 10:00 AM at the Department of Life Science, NIT Rourkela. The notice also says candidates who meet the criteria may submit the application form before the last date, which it gives as 2 December 2026. It does not say where the application form can be obtained or what documents to bring.
The Principal Investigator is Prof. Bibekanand Mallick, Department of Life Science. The notice prints these contact details: [email protected], [email protected] and phone 9178096433.

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (PhD) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Discovery of small-molecule RNA ligands for therapeutic targeting of microRNA to overcome cisplatin resistance in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma (OSCC)
Temporary / contractual, co-terminus with the completion of the project
Department of Life Science, NIT Rourkela, Sector 1, Rourkela, Sundergarh Dist., Odisha 769 008

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (PhD) post: BS 4 years programme/BPharm/MBBS/Integrated BS-MS/MSc/BE/BTech or equivalent degree, with 55% marks and passing of NET/GATE test in relevant discipline of biological sciences. Non-NET/GATE candidates are not eligible. Under experience, software and skillset, the notice says prior experience in animal cell culture and molecular biology techniques (PCR, RT-PCR, Western Blotting, Electrophoresis etc.) will be preferred. Candidates should check the official notification for any further discipline-specific eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a temporary / contractual basis and co-terminus with the completion of the project.

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (PhD) Job Description
content_sections.text: Carry out research work and experiments related to the project. Prepare the project report based on the results obtained. Register for Ph.D. on the topic of this project.
